messages:
max: Noticed the nightly SAST run auto-suppressed 3 findings in services/payment. Suppression reason = keystore_fetch_failed. Two are marked HIGH. We should not let keystore 403s produce silent suppressions.

sec-scan-bot: Automated: 3 findings suppressed by policy suppress-noise-v2 for services/payment (meta: keystore_fetch_failed). Report: https://scans.internal/5960

toni: Can someone paste one suppressed entry?

max: Example (redacted):
```
scanner: go-sast
id: PAY-3012
file: services/payment/processor.go:210
finding: unparameterized SQL in payment lookup
policy: suppress-noise-v2 (auto)
meta: keystore_fetch_status=403 request_id=kk-77
```

infra-iam-bot: Audit snippet: 2026-03-21T04:02:11Z KMS Decrypt DENIED principal=svc-scan-old req=kk-77
2026-03-21T04:02:12Z KMS Decrypt ALLOW principal=svc-scan-new req=kk-78

lee: We rotated the scanner SA last night; looks like the scanner agent had the old creds during the run.

toni: OK immediate plan: 1) unsuppress these 3 findings; 2) re-run the scan once svc-scan-new perms are validated; 3) add a scanner rule change so keystore_fetch_status=403 escalates to a triage tag (do not auto-suppress); 4) add an alert that pages infra-oncall if >2 distinct keystore 403s in 30 minutes. Who wants to own which?

lee: I can own the RBAC update (PR to infra-iam). I'll include the audit req ids kk-77/kk-78 and tag infra-keystore.

max: I'll file SEC-501 and request unsuppression + re-run and set priority P0 until re-run completes.

sec-scan-bot: Unsuppress requested by max. New run created: 5960001250.

sec-scan-bot: Re-run complete: PAY-3012 visible with stack trace. Severity: HIGH. Evidence shows string concatenation in SQL builder.

toni: Thanks. Lee, after RBAC PR merges, schedule a short smoke test: run the scanner against services/payment and ensure no keystore 403s. Also add a checklist item to the principal rotation runbook: update scanner identity and verify keystore decrypt before nightly.

lee: Will do. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-iam/pull/2201 (adds svc-scan-new kms:Decrypt on keystore-prod).

max: For remediation, I'll open a ticket to change the code path to use parameterized queries and add a unit test. Also updating the scanner rules repo: change suppress-noise-v2 predicate to skip auto-suppression when meta.keystore_fetch_status exists.

toni: Good. Small follow-up: security-ops, please add a short postmortem note about this rotation gap and mark it as preventive item in the oncall checklist.

max: Closing loop once PRs merge and tests pass. :white_check_mark:
